title: New Coinbase report points to ‘broken’ traditional finance system: Armstrong
summary: A new Coinbase–Ipsos survey shows younger US investors are trading more often, taking more risk and putting a far larger share of their portfolios into crypto.

title: Solana tests quantum-resistant transactions in new Project Eleven pilot
summary: Solana has partnered with a post-quantum security company to test quantum-resistant technology on a Solana testnet, claiming to offer a scalable end-to-end solution.

title: CAR’s crypto push fueled ‘state capture’ by elites, criminal networks: Report
summary: A new report warns that the Central African Republic’s crypto push favored elites and exposed the country to foreign criminal networks, rather than boosting financial inclusion.

title: Bitcoin price at ‘critical’ point as whale moves $348M BTC to exchanges
summary: A whale moved 4,000 Bitcoin to Binance, sparking fresh fears of a deeper BTC price drop if the $81,500 support level is lost.

title: Polymarket shows stronger retention than most DeFi, wallets and exchanges
summary: As crypto platforms explore prediction market integrations, retention data highlights why sustaining user engagement remains one of the industry’s most challenging tasks.

title: Bitcoin institutional buys flip new supply for the first time in 6 weeks
summary: Bitcoin buying power from institutions flipped the daily mined BTC supply for the first time since the start of November, new data showed.

title: KuCoin taps Tomorrowland festivals as MiCA-era on-ramp for European fans
summary: KuCoin is using a freshly minted MiCA license to wire crypto payments and perks into Tomorrowland’s flagship festivals.

title: Hyperliquid governance vote aims to permanently sideline $1B Assistance Fund
summary: The proposal seeks a binding social consensus that the funds will never be accessed through future protocol upgrades.

title: HashKey crypto exchange sees bumpy Hong Kong debut after $206M IPO
summary: HashKey debuted on Hong Kong’s HKEX following a $206 million oversubscribed IPO, with the stock seeing notable volatility on its first day of trading.

title: SEC lawsuit puts Shima Capital’s future in question as wind-down message surfaces
summary: Screenshots of an email shared online purportedly show founder Yida Gao stepping down as managing director of Shima Capital and outlining plans for an orderly wind-down of the fund.
